# World Explorer

> World Explorer is a 3D map of Earth built from real elevation data and satellite imagery. Its 3D Location Guesser game drops you anywhere on the planet and you pin your guess on a world map. Exploring the map is free with no signup; the guesser is a one-time €1 unlock with no subscription.

## Key facts
- Game: 3D Location Guesser, 10 rounds, up to 5,000 points per round (50,000 per game), score falls off with distance.
- Imagery: real 3D terrain plus satellite imagery you fly through; not Street View.
- Price: exploring is free; the guesser and 100 hand-picked wonders are a one-time €1 unlock.
- Multiplayer: none (solo, shareable score).
- URL: https://explorer.tadget.net/
